summary_markdown: The conversation focused on debugging technical issues encountered in the campaign reporting section following a code merge. Initially, an Angular error (NG0100) was observed when accessing the campaign list, though the list remained viewable. A more critical issue arose when attempting to open the campaign report, resulting in a `NullInjectorError` related to `FormatSecondsPipe`. The user suspected that removing `moment-timezone` from both client and server packages might have caused the pipe failure. After confirming the changes, someone reviewed the code, fixed the error, and pushed the fix.
decisions: The NullInjectorError for FormatSecondsPipe was resolved by a subsequent code push.
